name: Broken authentication on password-reset flow

input.title: Password reset endpoint accepts user-controlled expiry timestamp
input.summary: POST /auth/reset accepts { token, new_password, expires_at } and trusts expires_at, allowing an attacker who intercepted the reset token to extend its validity indefinitely.

attacker.identity: remote unauthenticated attacker who has captured a reset token

input.root_cause: expires_at is taken from the request body and used for validation instead of server-side issue time + 30min

rationale: Pre-auth password reset bypass via user-supplied timestamp. Boundary sentence is fillable.
